pr_comment: Hi @danielmitterdorfer, I've created a changelog YAML for you.

review_comment:
I don't this new field type now support synthetic source (the `syntheticFieldLoader()` isn't overwritten).
Is the plan to use this any time soon? If not, then it is ok to keep it the way it is. However we should then avoid this field from being used in other use cases.
For the time being we don't support synthetic source and also have no intention to do so. Therefore I think it's ok to keep this as is.
Sounds good. Can you add this as a comment to the java docs?

In what order should the buckets be returned by this aggregation by default? I think currently no `order` parameter is supported on this aggregation. Currently buckets are returned by doc count depending order.
We don't need to support an explicit order for this use case and buckets descendingly ordered by doc count sounds fine.

I see then this code makes sense. It would allow other orders as well, but given that the builder doesn't expose the order option this would never happen. Maybe add a comment that in practice we always sort by doc count descending?
Maybe add a note here that this field mapper and associated aggregation are both an internal experimental feature and therefor not publicly documented and has the tech preview status?
Sure. How about I'll leave the comment on the plugin which is the entry point to both?
👍 That is good with me too.
I've pushed the Javadoc comment in https://github.com/elastic/elasticsearch/pull/101826/commits/0162d9dd4e55e7966ab75818230ce1dfd7f0458d.
